compare, candidacy, living, cost, gallery, faq — the CMS repeater is in exactly the order
the template's ten bands are in (verified live). No code_section on this route: the page
imports no <LocalTrust>, so nothing here touches vs-content-model.php or
CodeSectionBlock.astro.
THE TEMPLATE'S OWN BAND COMMENTS WERE WRONG ABOUT COLOUR ON THREE BANDS AND THE VALUES
BELOW ARE READ OFF THE SHEET INSTEAD. `what`, `candidacy` and `cost` each carried a comment
saying "cream". `.aos4 .section.alt` is `background: var(--vs-charcoal-green)`
(all-on-4-single-arch.css:227), with h1-h4 #fff at :231, `.eyebrow` var(--vs-eyebrow-on-sage)
at :232 and p rgba(255,255,255,0.85) at :235 — a DARK band with white type. Copying the
comment would have repainted three of the ten bands cream and put white headings on a cream
plate, because every block derives its type colours from `band` and not from an ancestor
class. `.section.alt` is cream on teeth-whitening.css:237 and charcoal here; the class name
is not the colour. `.aos4 .section.dark` is var(--vs-sage-pale) (:237), pale despite the
name, and `.aos4 .section` (:226) is padding only, so a bare `.section` is the body paper.
Every `band_evidence` below names the rule it was read from.
FOUR OF THE TEN BANDS CARRY A SECOND SHAPE INSIDE THEM, AND NO REGISTERED LAYOUT HAS A SLOT
FOR ONE. `what` ends in `.what-sub` (a head, a two-card `.config-grid`, a closing
paragraph); `compare` ends in `.compare-sub` (a head and a three-card `.alternatives-grid`);
`candidacy` and `living` each end in a `.candidacy-sub` (a `.label`, an <h3>, a paragraph).
Each is a known_gap on its block. media_split's `callout_heading` / `callout_body` and
comparison_cards' were NOT pressed into service for them: those two draw
`<aside class="veneers-callout">` and `<aside class="safety-callout">`, which are
teeth-whitening's classes and teeth-whitening's shape — an h3 and prose, no `.label`, no
card grid. Using them would move this page's copy into markup it has never had, and the
rule this whole file is governed by is that a backfilled band renders IDENTICAL markup.
A gap that is recorded is recoverable; a band quietly rebuilt out of the nearest-fitting
field is not.
TWO `cards` GROUPS FEED THOSE SUB-SHAPES AND ARE THEREFORE EXEMPT, NOT CLAIMED. `archConfigs`
(2 rows) is the `.config-grid` inside `what`; `alternatives` (3 rows) is the
`.alternatives-grid` inside `compare`. Both are named in `exempt.cards` with a reason. This
matters mechanically as well as morally: backfill-blocks.php stops before writing anything
on a `cards` group that is neither claimed by a block nor named in `exempt`, so leaving them
out entirely would fail the run rather than lose the rows silently — which is the behaviour
worth keeping, and the reason the check exists.
THIS PAGE'S `cards` REPEATER IS NOT EMPTY, UNLIKE porcelain-veneers'. Thirteen rows in four
groups, verified live: whyCards (4), livingCards (4), alternatives (3), archConfigs (2). Two
of the four groups are MOVED into block repeaters rather than transcribed, which is why the
`why` and `living` blocks below carry `{ "cards": "<group>" }` rows and not literals.
`robotics` IS THE BAND THE media_split HEADER SAYS DOES NOT EXIST. That component's header
asserts, as a measured fact across six sheets, that no page in src/pages mixes the two class
families — "no `.what-grid` with the image second, no `.natural-img` in landscape". The
unstated third mix is this one: photo FIRST like `.what-*` (all-on-4-single-arch.astro:463
puts `.robotics-img` before `.robotics-text`) with a PORTRAIT plate like `.natural-*`
(all-on-4-single-arch.css:308-311 gives `.what-img`, `.robotics-img` and `.natural-img` a
shared aspect-ratio 4/5, and the :316 override back to 5/4 names `.what-img` alone). The
block ties the frame to the side, so this row keeps the side and the column split and
records the frame as a gap. See that block's known_gaps for why the trade goes this way.
CTA ROWS SPLIT THE SAME THREE WAYS AS ON BOTH WORKED EXAMPLES, and the split is the
components' decision, not this file's. `compare` and `process` draw their rows entirely from
the component and their layouts have no cta sub-fields, so nothing is supplied for them;
`what` and `faq` gate their rows on cta_label being filled, so those two carry transcribed
pairs; `cost` has a row and pricing_tiers has no cta fields at all, which is a gap on that
block. All ten `sections` rows on this page return ctaLabel and ctaHref null — verified
live — so there was never anything to move.
THE RAIL SURVIVES INTACT. Nine toc_links rows — why, what, robotics, process, compare,
candidacy, living, cost, faq — in the template's order, every one claimed by a block's
section_id. Ten blocks produce nine rail entries because `gallery` has no toc_links row and
resolves to a blank nav_label, which is what keeps it out of the rail today and what keeps
it out of the derived rail after the switch.

THE TRADE, STATED SO THE NEXT READER DOES NOT RE-LITIGATE IT: `media_side: right` would
give the correct 4/5 frame and move the photograph to the other side of the page,
